_comment: E7 alone, as frozen on 12 November (the submission is configs/b2_ens_dr_alive.json), with the external simulator (domain randomisation, 11 player slots per team): equal-weight average of P(alive) and P(home|alive) of E0, E1, E2, E5, each trained on all development matches for the mean of its validated steps. Decoder chosen again on the out-of-fold predictions of these models (experiments/f4d_rule.md, experiments/decoder_select.md): team-swapped inference averaged (usual rule passed); no minimum possession duration (not passed); team-switch cost 3 and stoppage cost 8 by the zone score over three sources; ball-out rule (law of the game) with min_out_m 2.0 and min_s 0.3, no source worse by more than 2 paired SE and no systematic detection error; boundary shifts not adopted. Nothing tuned on BAR-ATH.
